description: Phase 4 benchmark for NL-to-SQL, routing, safety and hybrid RAG + SQL answers. Gold SQL is the reference used to compute expected results; the system never sees it. Document-routing questions are taken from benchmark_v2.json (all 25 must route to the document pipeline).

datasets.note: ArcelorMittal Annual Report 2025, segment sales and operating income (page 95) and FTE employees (page 130)
Fictional customers and orders (fixed seed), sheets customers and orders plus an empty sheet

questions.question: What is the total revenue of all orders in the orders table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders

questions.question: How many orders in the orders data were placed in 2025?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

questions.question: What is the average quantity in tonnes of Rebar orders in the orders table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity_tonnes) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE product = 'Rebar'

questions.question: What is the largest single order revenue in the orders data?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders

questions.question: What is the smallest order quantity in tonnes in the orders table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(quantity_tonnes) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders

questions.question: What is the total order revenue per customer region in the orders data?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders o JOIN steel_orders_sample_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region

questions.question: Which 3 customers have the highest total order revenue in the orders table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM steel_orders_sample_orders o JOIN steel_orders_sample_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY SUM(o.revenue_usd) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What was the total revenue per product in 2024 in the orders data?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT product, SUM(revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY product

questions.question: Show the monthly order revenue in 2025 from the orders table.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date), SUM(revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many orders in the orders table have revenue above 1,000,000 USD?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE revenue_usd > 1000000

questions.question: How many customers are there per industry in the customers table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) FROM steel_orders_sample_customers GROUP BY industry

questions.question: What was the total order revenue in the first quarter of 2025 in the orders data?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'

questions.question: Which segment had the highest operating income in 2025 in the segment KPI table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT segment FROM segment_kpis WHERE year = 2025 ORDER BY operating_income_usd_m DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What were the total employees across all segments in 2025 in the segment KPI table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(employees_fte) FROM segment_kpis WHERE year = 2025

questions.question: How did Europe sales change between 2024 and 2025 in the segment KPI table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT year, sales_usd_m FROM segment_kpis WHERE segment = 'Europe' ORDER BY year

questions.question: What share of 2025 employees in the segment KPI data does each segment have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT segment, employees_fte FROM segment_kpis WHERE year = 2025

questions.question: List the segments by 2025 operating income from highest to lowest in the segment KPI table.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT segment FROM segment_kpis WHERE year = 2025 ORDER BY operating_income_usd_m DESC

questions.question: What is the average revenue per order for each customer region in the orders data?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region, AVG(o.revenue_usd) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders o JOIN steel_orders_sample_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region

questions.question: How many orders did Northwind Fabrication place according to the orders table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders o JOIN steel_orders_sample_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'Northwind Fabrication'

questions.question: What total quantity of Galvanized sheet was sold in 2025 according to the orders data?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity_tonnes) FROM steel_orders_sample_orders WHERE product = 'Galvanized sheet' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

questions.question: What was the profit margin of each order in the orders table?
questions.reason: The orders table has revenue but no cost or profit column.

questions.gold_sql: SELECT segment FROM segment_kpis WHERE year = 2025 ORDER BY employees_fte DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Mining's operating income in 2025 in the segment KPI table, and what was the total operating income in 2025 according to the annual report?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT operating_income_usd_m FROM segment_kpis WHERE segment = 'Mining' AND year = 2025
